summary: Swvl Holdings Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting that it regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rules 5550(b)(1) and 5550(b)(3). The company had fallen out of compliance on October 31, 2025, with a 180-day cure period ending April 29, 2026. Based on its 2025 20-F, it reported $2.9M stockholders' equity and $1.3M net income, satisfying both minimum requirements. No price, premium, or board recommendation. This is a routine compliance update; no special situation.
